en.reason: Nvidia researchers argue that as context windows balloon from GPT-4's 8,192 tokens to roughly 1 million, periodic summaries plus targeted keyword search matched full-context results at a fraction of the cost.

en.reason: Inkling 2 Mini is an open looped transformer from Thinking Machines that runs 12 of its 24 layers three times per token for longer internal reasoning at fewer tokens, tying Qwen3.8 27B on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index at roughly six times lower cost.

en.title: Universal wisdom for you and your Agent: 12 foundational common-sense principles and execution rules for knowledge workers (with open-source Skill uw-mode)
en.summary: Keep reminding AI to "think it through before acting and check before delivering," yet it still goes off the rails? The author rewrote 12 everyday working principles—begin with the end in mind, the 80/20 rule, reverse thinking—into concrete rules an Agent can execute: when to ask follow-up questions, when to stop and recheck, and what must be verified before delivery. It might just help!

en.title: Loop Engineering and Graph Engineering: A Complete Guide to Running Agents Autonomously
en.summary: This Agent engineering approach proposes a dual-layer "loop + dependency graph" architecture to solve the pain point of developers reviewing line by line and becoming a bottleneck in the process.
en.reason: Using a JavaScript-to-TypeScript migration as its example, the guide explains a two-layer agent architecture: check.sh runs tsc, vitest and git diff to catch failures and retry, while dependency graphs split tasks and avoid any-typing gaps.

en.reason: Groundwork introduces a plan format for Claude Code built so re-runs never overwrite existing plans, addressing what happens when AI coding tasks are executed repeatedly and the original plan must be preserved.

## 我造了一个 Java 能力包：让 AI 直接调用你的业务代码
> 一个注解，把你的业务方法变成大模型能用的工具。 本文源码已开源：[gitee.com/wizard-cn/u…](https://link.juejin.cn/?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgitee.com%2Fwizard-cn%2Fum-sdk "https://gitee.com/wizard-cn/um-sdk")
今天不聊概念，聊一个我自己造、自己天天在用的东西——**um-sdk**。
它解决的问题很朴素：**Java 项目里那些反反复复要写一遍的东西，能不能只写一次？**
工具类、枚举、支付、邮件、缓存……每个项目都要抄一遍。更麻烦的是，这两年大家都在接大模型、接 AI 助手，可业务代码怎么让 AI 调起来，又是一套全新的体力活。
于是我干脆把这些都收进了一个包，还顺手把 AI 那一层也焊了进去。
一句话：**一套依赖，干掉日常
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者开源um-sdk，用@McpTool注解把订单查询方法变成AI可调用工具，并集成6个零框架强依赖基础模块和20多个静态工具类，减少Java重复代码。

en.title: I built a Java capability package that lets AI call your business code directly
en.summary:
# I Built a Java Capability Package That Lets AI Call Your Business Code Directly

> One annotation turns your business methods into tools a large model can use. Source code is open-sourced: [gitee.com/wizard-cn/u…](https://link.juejin.cn/?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgitee.com%2Fwizard-cn%2Fum-sdk "https://gitee.com/wizard-cn/um-sdk")

No concepts today — let's talk about something I built and use every day: **um-sdk**.

The problem it solves is simple: **can all that stuff you rewrite over and over in Java projects be written just once?**

Utility classes, enums, payments, email, caching... every project copies them all over again. What's worse, everyone's been wiring up large models and AI assistants these past two years, but getting your business code callable by AI is a whole new pile of manual labor.

So I bundled all of it into one package and welded the AI layer in while I was at it.

In a word: **one dependency to replace the everyday busywork.**
en.reason: The open-source um-sdk uses an @McpTool annotation to turn an order-query method into an AI-callable tool, bundling 6 framework-independent base modules and 20-plus static utility classes to cut repeated Java code.

Week-long efforts to agree a negotiating mandate for a legally binding international treaty to control the use of autonomous weapons collapsed just before 5am after all-night talks failed to overcome
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇报道记录联合国CCW控制自主武器谈判在日内瓦通宵至凌晨5点前破裂：Russia阻挠令128个缔约方仅通过以共识拟定的弱化授权，而非100多国推动的新法。

en.reason: Week-long UN talks in Geneva on a legally binding autonomous-weapons treaty collapsed before 5am after all-night negotiations, with Russian filibustering leaving 128 states to adopt a weakened consensus mandate rather than the new law backed by over 100 countries.

stories.title: Upload2Shell：Ghostscript CVE-2026-125396 漏洞可穿越沙箱执行命令

sources.title: Upload2Shell：Ghostscript CVE-2026-125396 漏洞可穿越沙箱执行命令
sources.title_zh: Upload2Shell：Ghostscript CVE-2026-125396 漏洞可穿越沙箱执行命令
sources.title_en: Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396)
sources.title_original: Upload2Shell (CVE-2026-125396)
sources.summary:
A use-after-free in Ghostscript’s Type 1 font loader lets a crafted document cross Ghostscript’s -dSAFER sandbox, alter native path controls, and execute attacker-chosen commands as the rendering process.
Ghostscript sits beneath print, email, upload, and preview workflows. Our ImageMagick research showed how files named .png or .jpg can still reach Ghostscript through image conversion. The index below records confirmed affected paths alongside additional applications whose renderer routes we tr
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章披露 Ghostscript Type 1 字体加载器的 use-after-free（CVE-2026-125396）可绕过 -dSAFER，并在 Google 文档渲染、WordPress 上传、Debian 13 的 IPP 队列和 Roundcube 缩略图路径中确认执行命令，上游修复对应 Artifex Bug 709684。

en.reason: A use-after-free in Ghostscript’s Type 1 font loader (CVE-2026-125396) bypasses -dSAFER to execute attacker-chosen commands, with confirmed command execution in Google Docs rendering, WordPress uploads, Debian 13 IPP queues and Roundcube thumbnails, fixed by Artifex Bug 709684.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以Epoch AI数据揭示AI双极格局：2022年至2026年6月U.S.获全球新增AI算力约72%、China获10%，其余国家合计仅18%，并追问这种集中如何削弱多数国家对AI建设、测试与治理的话语权。

en.reason: Epoch AI data showing the U.S. captured roughly 72% of new global AI compute from 2022 to June 2026 and China 10%, leaving all other countries just 18%, frames this argument that the Washington-Beijing rivalry leaves most nations with little say over how AI is built, tested, and governed.
